articles.author: Stjepan Kalinic
articles.headline: Bond Markets Are Rethinking Big Tech’s $1 Trillion+ a Year for AI
articles.summary: Big Tech's AI capex boom is wiping out free cash flow. Discover how data center spending is changing tech investing forever.
articles._summary: “Investors are ​underestimating how fundamentally AI is changing the Big Tech business model,” Shay Boloor , chief market strategist at Futurum Equities , said, according to Reuters. “These companies were historically valued as asset-light platforms because ​revenue could scale much faster than capital requirements, but AI is pushing them toward a hybrid model where software, advertising and cloud economics increasingly depend on enormous physical infrastructure spending,” he added.
articles._zh_headline: 债券市场正在重新思考大型科技公司每年为人工智能投入超过 1 万亿美元的资金
articles._zh_summary: 据路透社报道，Futurum Equities 首席市场策略师 Shay Boloor 表示：“投资者低估了人工智能对大型科技商业模式的根本改变。”他补充道：“这些公司历来被视为轻资产平台，因为收入的增长速度可能远远快于资本需求，但人工智能正在推动它们走向一种混合模式，在这种模式中，软件、广告和云经济越来越依赖于巨大的物理基础设施支出。”

articles.author: Anusuya Lahiri
articles.headline: Western Digital Stock Is Gaining Monday: What's Going On?
articles.summary: Western Digital (WDC) gains 3% premarket alongside STX and MU as tech rebounds. Key levels and Q2 earnings forecast analyzed inside.
articles._summary: Western Digital Corp. (NASDAQ: WDC ) stock rose about 3% in Monday’s premarket trading as investors returned to higher-risk technology stocks. Nasdaq futures climbed 1.43%, while S&P 500 futures gained 0.89%. Western Digital’s gains appeared to track the broader market rally rather than company-specific news. The stock is rebounding after pulling back from its June high as investors rotate back into technology shares ahead of the opening bell.
articles._zh_headline: 西部数据股票周一上涨：发生了什么？
articles._zh_summary: 随着投资者重返高风险科技股，西部数据公司（纳斯达克股票代码：WDC）股价在周一盘前交易中上涨约 3%。纳斯达克期货上涨 1.43%，标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 0.89%。西部数据的涨幅似乎是跟随更广泛的市场上涨，而不是公司特定的新闻。随着投资者在开盘前重新投资科技股，该股从 6 月高点回落后正在反弹。

articles.author: Anusuya Lahiri
articles.headline: What's Going on With Sandisk Stock Monday?
articles.summary: SanDisk (SNDK) stock jumped 4%+ premarket as chip stocks rally ahead of Aug. 5 earnings. Key technical levels & analyst outlook inside.
articles._summary: The broader market rally helped lift Sandisk after the stock pulled back from its June peak. The rebound comes just over a week before the company’s quarterly earnings report, a period that often brings increased trading activity and volatility. Despite the recent decline, Sandisk remains one of the market’s biggest winners over the past 12 months, with shares up more than 3,329%. That sharp rally has made the stock susceptible to profit-taking and buy-the-dip trading.
articles._zh_summary: 在Sandisk股票从6月份的高点回落后，大盘的上涨帮助该公司提振。反弹发生在该公司发布季度收益报告的一周多前，这一时期通常会带来交易活动增加和波动性。尽管最近有所下跌，Sandisk 仍然是过去 12 个月市场的最大赢家之一，股价上涨超过 3,329%。这种大幅上涨使该股容易受到获利了结和逢低买入交易的影响。

articles.author: Badar Shaikh
articles.headline: Uber-Backed EV Firm Says Iran War Is Accelerating Electric Vehicle Adoption in South Africa
articles.summary: Valternative, a fleet operator backed by Uber, says the US-Iran war has accelerated EV penetration in South Africa.
articles._summary: While Qute offers an alternative to traditional tuk-tuks but remains powered by fossil fuels, Valternative and Uber’s approach is an electric one and the Iran war is helping drive electrification in a country where infrastructure remains sparse, the report said. Fuel costs in South Africa remain high as the conflict sends supply shocks throughout the world and Jeewa said that South African drivers or customers would not return to ICE vehicles once they “get a taste of electric,” the report outlined.
articles._zh_headline: Uber支持的电动汽车公司表示，伊朗战争正在加速南非电动汽车的采用
articles._zh_summary: 报告称，虽然 Qute 提供了传统嘟嘟车的替代方案，但仍然由化石燃料提供动力，但 Valternative 和 Uber 的方法是电动的，而伊朗战争正在帮助推动这个基础设施仍然稀疏的国家的电气化。报告概述称，由于冲突给世界各地的供应带来冲击，南非的燃料成本仍然很高，吉瓦表示，南非司机或顾客一旦“尝到了电动车的滋味”，就不会再使用内燃机汽车了。

articles.author: Avi Kapoor
articles.headline: IBM, Amazon, Alphabet And More: CNBC’s ‘Final Trades’
articles.summary: Experts recommend Goldman Sachs Nasdaq-100 ETF, IBM, Alphabet, and Amazon ahead of earnings. IBM beat estimates, Alphabet and Amazon report soon.
articles._summary: Stephanie Link , chief investment strategist, head of investment solutions and equity portfolio manager at Hightower Advisors, said she likes International Business Machines Corporation (NYSE: IBM ) . Lending support to her choice, IBM, on July 22, reported second-quarter revenue of $17.16 billion, beating the consensus estimate of $16.86 billion, according to Benzinga Pro. The company reported second-quarter adjusted earnings of $2.93 per share, beating analyst estimates of $2.86 per share.
articles._zh_headline: IBM、亚马逊、Alphabet 等：CNBC 的“最终交易”
articles._zh_summary: Hightower Advisors 首席投资策略师、投资解决方案主管和股票投资组合经理 Stephanie Link 表示，她喜欢国际商业机器公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：IBM）。根据 Benzinga Pro 的数据，IBM 在 7 月 22 日公布了第二季度营收 171.6 亿美元，超过了市场普遍预期的 168.6 亿美元，为她的选择提供了支持。该公司报告第二季度调整后每股收益为 2.93 美元，超出分析师预期的每股 2.86 美元。

articles.author: Anusuya Lahiri
articles.headline: Wall Street Sees Little Threat to Micron From China’s Memory Giant
articles.summary: Micron stock surges premarket despite China's CXMT block-buster IPO. Analysts say MU holds the edge in high-growth AI memory.
articles._summary: The broader market rally coincided with a major development in the global memory-chip industry that could reshape long-term competitive dynamics. ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT), China’s leading DRAM maker, made a blockbuster stock market debut that underscores Beijing’s push to build a domestic memory champion. While the listing highlights rising competition in commodity memory, analysts believe Micron remains well positioned in the faster-growing AI memory market.
articles._zh_headline: 华尔街认为中国内存巨头对美光科技的威胁不大
articles._zh_summary: 更广泛的市场上涨恰逢全球存储芯片行业的重大发展，这可能重塑长期竞争动态。中国领先的 DRAM 制造商长鑫存储技术有限公司（CXMT）在股市首次亮相时表现出色，突显了北京打造国内存储龙头企业的努力。虽然此次上市凸显了商品内存领域的竞争日益激烈，但分析师认为，美光科技在快速增长的人工智能内存市场中仍处于有利地位。

articles.author: Rishabh Mishra
articles.headline: Stock Market: Will S&P 500 Open Up or Down Today?
articles.summary: Polymarket S&P 500 up open odds hit 88% on July 27 as a pause in U.S. strikes on Iran sends crude oil prices tumbling.
articles._summary: U.S. stock futures are rising heading into Monday morning, driven by a temporary lull in Middle East hostilities and a steep pullback in global energy prices. Markets received a substantial boost over the weekend following news that the United States suspended its 13-night airstrike campaign against Iran to allow space for diplomatic negotiations and evaluate depleted munitions stocks.
articles._zh_headline: 股市：今天标普 500 指数会上涨还是下跌？
articles._zh_summary: 受中东敌对行动暂时平息和全球能源价格大幅回落的推动，美国股指期货周一上午上涨。周末有消息称，美国暂停对伊朗进行为期 13 晚的空袭行动，为外交谈判留出空间并评估耗尽的弹药库存，市场大幅提振。

articles.author: Badar Shaikh
articles.headline: Peter Schiff Says Elon Musk Lost $100 Billion Amid Tesla, SpaceX Selloff: 'I'm an Elon Fan'
articles.summary: Peter Schiff comments on Elon Musk's $100B loss in wealth due to Tesla and SpaceX stock declines, but clarifies he is not criticizing Musk.
articles._summary: In a series of posts on X on Friday, the Echelon Wealth Partners co-founder said that Musk lost nearly $100 billion in a week. “I’m old enough to remember when $100 billion was a lot of money,” he said. Schiff then responded to a user in the thread, who said that Musk was creating value for the world and that the dip was not permanent. “I’m an Elon fan,” Schiff said, adding that the post was not criticizing the Tesla CEO. “I wish I was rich enough to ‘lose’ $100 billion in one week,” he said.
articles._zh_headline: 彼得·希夫称埃隆·马斯克因特斯拉、SpaceX 抛售而损失了 1000 亿美元：“我是埃隆·马斯克的粉丝”
articles._zh_summary: 周五，这位 Echelon Wealth Partners 联合创始人在 X 上的一系列帖子中表示，马斯克在一周内损失了近 1000 亿美元。 “我已经足够大了，还记得 1000 亿美元是一笔巨款，”他说。希夫随后在帖子中回复了一位用户，该用户表示马斯克正在为世界创造价值，而且这种下滑并不是永久性的。 “我是埃隆的粉丝，”希夫说，并补充说该帖子并不是批评特斯拉首席执行官。 “我希望自己足够富有，能够在一周内‘损失’ 1000 亿美元，”他说。

articles.author: Tanya Rawat
articles.headline: Gen X Retirement Nears With S&P 500 Portfolios Riding a Boom: Advisor Says Real Danger Isn't a Crash, but One That Comes at the 'Wrong Time'
articles.summary: Gen X retirement portfolios face growing market risk as advisers warn about S&P 500 concentration and AI-linked stocks.
articles._summary: Financial advisers are warning that Gen X investors approaching retirement could be particularly vulnerable to a market downturn as heavy exposure to the S&P 500 coincides with growing concentration in AI-linked stocks, according to a CNBC report published Sunday. Gen X, generally defined as those born between 1965 and 1980, is entering a period when years of accumulating retirement savings increasingly overlap with the need to protect money that may soon be used for income.
articles._zh_headline: 随着标普 500 指数投资组合的繁荣，X 一代即将退休：顾问表示，真正的危险不是崩盘，而是在“错误的时间”出现的危机
articles._zh_summary: 据 CNBC 周日发布的一份报告称，财务顾问警告说，即将退休的 X 一代投资者可能特别容易受到市场低迷的影响，因为他们在标准普尔 500 指数中的大量投资与人工智能相关股票的集中度不断提高相一致。 X一代通常被定义为1965年至1980年之间出生的人，他们正在进入这样一个时期：多年积累的退休储蓄与保护可能很快用于收入的资金的需求越来越重叠。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Top Three ETFs to Watch This Week: TQQQ, MAGS, SCHD
articles.summary: ETFs are having a strong year, with inflows surpassing $1 trillion and total assets under management steadily approaching the $16 trillion mark.
articles._summary: Exchange-traded funds (ETFs) are having a strong year, with inflows surpassing $1 trillion and total assets under management steadily approaching the $16 trillion mark. The ETF has experienced over $949 million in inflows in the last month, a sign that investors expect tech stocks to do well. This week will be crucial for the fund as most of its constituent companies publish their financial results. The ETF is also sensitive to the actions of the Federal Reserve.
articles._zh_headline: 本周值得关注的三大 ETF：TQQQ、MAGS、SCHD
articles._zh_summary: 交易所交易基金 (ETF) 今年表现强劲，资金流入超过 1 万亿美元，管理总资产稳步逼近 16 万亿美元大关。上个月，该 ETF 的资金流入超过 9.49 亿美元，这表明投资者预计科技股将表现良好。本周对于该基金来说至关重要，因为大多数旗下公司都会公布财务业绩。 ETF 对美联储的行动也很敏感。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Top Four Magnificent 7 Stocks to Watch This Week: Apple, Microsoft, Meta, Amazon
articles.summary: The top Magnificent 7 stocks to watch this week include popular names like Apple, Microsoft, Meta and Amazon.
articles._summary: Microsoft has become one of the worst-performing Magnificent Seven stocks this year as it dropped by over 30% from its all-time high. The stock has slumped because of the ongoing SaaSPocalypse fears and its growing capital expenditure. In the last financial results, the company hinted that it will spend over $190 billion in capex this year. There are also concerns about Copilot, its AI bot, whose market share has lagged behind ChatGPT and Claude.
articles._zh_headline: 本周最值得关注的 7 只股票：苹果、微软、Meta、亚马逊
articles._zh_summary: 微软已成为今年表现最差的七大股票之一，较历史最高点下跌了 30% 以上。由于持续的 SaaSPocalypse 担忧及其不断增长的资本支出，该股已经暴跌。在最新的财务业绩中，该公司暗示今年的资本支出将超过 1900 亿美元。人们还担心其人工智能机器人 Copilot，其市场份额落后于 ChatGPT 和 Claude。

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: CXMT Becomes China's Most Valuable Listed Company After Memory Chipmaker Surges 500% on Debut
articles.summary: China's ChangXin Memory Technologies surged more than 500% in its Shanghai debut, becoming China's most valuable listed company.
articles._summary: China’s ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) soared more than 500% in its Shanghai debut on Monday, becoming the country’s most valuable listed company by market capitalization. CXMT raised 57.92 billion yuan ($8.55 billion) after pricing its IPO at 8.66 yuan ($1.28) per share, making it Asia’s biggest public offering so far this year. The surge made CXMT the most valuable company listed in China, surpassing Industrial and Commercial Bank of China , which previously held the top spot by market value.
articles._zh_headline: 内存芯片制造商首日暴涨500%，长鑫存储成中国最具价值上市公司
articles._zh_summary: 中国长鑫存储科技有限公司（CXMT）周一在上海上市，股价飙升超过 500%，成为中国市值最高的上市公司。长鑫存储将其 IPO 定价为每股 8.66 元（1.28 美元），筹集了 579.2 亿元人民币（85.5 亿美元），成为今年迄今为止亚洲最大的公开发行。此次飙升使长鑫存储超越此前市值排名第一的中国工商银行，成为中国市值最高的上市公司。

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: Nvidia Deepens South Korea AI Push With $1 Billion NAVER Investment
articles.summary: NVIDIA to invest $1B in NAVER to expand South Korea's AI datacenter infrastructure.
articles._summary: NVIDIA Corp (NASDAQ: NVDA ) plans to invest about $1 billion in NAVER Corp as part of a broader effort to expand artificial intelligence datacenter infrastructure in South Korea. A regulatory filing from NAVER on Monday said NVIDIA will buy 7.2 million newly issued shares at 204,500 KRW ($139.45) each, about a 1% discount to NAVER’s Friday closing price, as part of its planned $1 billion investment.
articles._zh_headline: Nvidia 投资 10 亿美元 NAVER 深化韩国人工智能发展
articles._zh_summary: NVIDIA 公司（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）计划向 NAVER 公司投资约 10 亿美元，作为扩大韩国人工智能数据中心基础设施的更广泛努力的一部分。 NAVER 周一向监管机构提交的文件称，NVIDIA 将以每股 204,500 韩元（139.45 美元）的价格购买 720 万股新发行的股票，比 NAVER 周五收盘价折价约 1%，作为其计划的 10 亿美元投资的一部分。
